_what: PLA-464 Option A, Trevor's rulings D1-D6 of 2026-09-16 (D5 amended after measurement, see mulberry's finding). Retire the six rootstock_options[] rows that are not rootstocks; fold one crop-specific sentence into recommended_rootstock_note on three crops with the row's sources carried in field_additions; null fig's recommended_rootstock and rewrite mulberry's; record the provenance gaps as open_findings routed to PLA-533 and PLA-7 Plan B; mulberry's 15 gal KEPT and asserted unchanged. Five crops, nothing else.

note_foldins.sentence: With no rootstock to resist root-knot nematode, a nematode-free, well-drained site is the real substitute for rootstock choice.
On an own-root tree there is no graft union to keep above the soil, and any suckers are the same variety.
An ungrafted seedling is a cheaper way to a tree, but expect variable fruit and a wait of about 5 to 8 years instead of around 4 for a grafted variety.

The 15 gal figure is UNANCHORED. The absence is scoped to that document only.
entry.resolution_note: Trevor's ruling D5 (2026-09-16) was to null both figures if absent. Measured on a scratch copy, a null reddens display_readiness and whole_crop_gate section 3 on any container_ok true crop, and mulberry's container_ok true was ruled on the crop's own cultivar sentence, not on this figure. The 15 is therefore KEPT as an explicit placeholder pending PLA-533, where mulberry is first in the queue: re-derive from a container technique source admitted by PLA-532, and replace it, or null it together with the flip decision, there.

entry.summary: The retired rootstock_options[] row 'Own-root / genetic dwarf (North Star, Meteor)' named two cultivars, not a rootstock.
